display_long_description:
# DEMO RELEASE

**WASTE** is a blend of "Operation Blockade", uncomfortable thoughts, confusion and existential dread.

Make your own gun, shoot the planes down and most importantly: **absolutely don't think about anything else**. 

It doesn't matter if you understand what is going on ~~inside~~ around you after all.


# DISCLAIMER

Do you feel like the game is hard, unfair or too vague and you just don't know what you are supposed to do?

Good.

Remember - it's your choice. You **can always** just keep your brain turned off and scroll the feed instead. Who cares?

-

# A few words that most will skip

It took me 360 days to make this demo.

I worked alone, mostly offline. I did not want to use ready assets and I have serious, visceral reaction to anything AI, so I made everything myself.
That means:
- I drew every picture and texture
- I wrote every shader
- I wrote every line of code
- I wrote every line of text
- I designed and recorded every sound
- I played, composed and recorded every note
- I modeled and animated every 3D asset
- I designed and drew each font, letter by letter

and did absolutely everything else with my own hands.

And it was significantly more draining than I anticipated, but here is the fruit, for better or for worse.
